dtm_source: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 2022, 1 m, tiles TQ27ne TQ27nw TQ28se TQ28sw (environment.data.gov.uk), vertical datum ODN (m AOD)
transform: Inverse of UTM zone 30N + Inverse of OSGB36 to WGS 84 (9) + British National Grid

grid_4m.aggregation: mean DTM / building fraction >= 0.5 / mean roof height of building cells

hole_rule: nodata or < -2.0 m AOD -> nearest valid cell

buildings.block_rule: bed = DTM + max(roof height, 3 m) on building cells (building-block method; roofs are not flow paths)

landcover: grass / vegetation from geometry_model/geometry/south_kensington_core008_landcover_4m (4 m, core008.glb materials), nearest-4m on the 1 m grid
